assembly_metadata: Measured candidate compiled before local commits, with 3bd89bcafe in informational metadata; file hashes bind it to the committed implementation. Both harness builds use identical benchmark sources; their binary hashes differ after compilation against changed implementation metadata.

host_policy.placement: Default OS scheduling across heterogeneous M4 cores; no affinity

measurement.comparison: One baseline bracketed by two candidate launches; these are not two independent baseline pairs. Earlier controls and the inline-dispatch experiment are retained separately.

validation: Every timed package passes strict OfficeIMO parsing and independent ExcelDataReader verification of every header, row and typed value. XLS also checks Index/DBCell structure. All operations include creation, row generation, serialization, finalization and complete byte[] output. Buffered-cell diagnostic compares OfficeIMO revisions only, separately from equivalent-work engine lanes.

earlier_run_interpretation.after-1 and after-2: Typed capture dispatched inside the large object-row method. This layout is superseded after selector timing differences.
earlier_run_interpretation.control-1 and control-2: Baseline engine with the added public buffered-cell diagnostic.

profile.workload: Only XLSB OfficeIMO generated selector writer; one case, 2 warmups, 4 measurements, 128 invocations; sampled-thread-time and verbose GC. Diagnostic samples are not the reported timing results.

compatibility.enumeration_and_selectors: Enumeration completes and disposes before row-major selector invocation. Selectors run before WriteData returns; values remain captured for saves. Indexed caller-owned sources retain per-selector reads.
compatibility.native_snapshot: All typed cells are validated and copied before destination writes; no source buffer is borrowed during emission.

smoke: PASS | Constructor-bound worksheet and table records retain values and native schemas
PASS | Excel DataReader, typed, and generic-only dictionary tables create, save, and reload

limits: Normal M4 scheduling; earlier timing variation is retained.
net472 cross-build only; Windows runtime not exercised.
Selector value-type results still box through the existing Func<T, object?> contract.
Comparison assemblies predate local commits; exact source and assembly hashes are retained.
